why: Source: profit per unit, divide by unit size, scale to per thousand, discard the unused variable (4 steps); question: the same four steps with loaves, kilograms and tonnes, so no difference.

Source: current servicing and electricity cost, new servicing and electricity cost, annual saving, times three years (about 6 steps); question: the same six steps on the same table layout, so no difference.

Source: read five revenue and five headcount bars, five divisions, rank, match option (about 4 steps); question: the same readings, divisions, ranking and option match (about 4 steps), so no difference.

Source: read one country's share and margin off an unlabelled scatter, market times share, sales times margin, avoid the sales-figure trap (5 steps); question: the same gridline reads, two multiplications and the same trap (5 steps).
Source: pick the basic-rate row over PPP, divide income by rate for four countries, compare (about 3 steps); question: the same row choice, four divisions and comparison (about 3 steps).

Source: funnel of four percentages to paying clients, value times reduction times tax rate, halve, multiply (about 4 steps); question: the same funnel, per-client credit, halving and multiplication (about 4 steps).
Source: daily to weekly cost, disposal cost per customer, contribution, break-even division, round up to the next option (5 steps); question: the same five steps with offices and a recycling charge.

Source: test four statements, one via margin ratios, one via revenue products, one via profit comparison, one spotting missing non-customer share (about 5 steps); question: the same four statement types on the same table layout (about 5 steps).

Source: profit for each period from revenue minus costs, divide by units for each, percentage change, match option (about 4 steps); question: the same subtraction, divisions, percentage change and match (about 4 steps).
Source: annual visitors divided by 365, times the once-only share (2 steps); question: the same division and percentage (2 steps), so no difference.
